purpose: Run one bounded integration block and the fresh 64-paper all-child support gate before any Stage D scientific training.

history.v4_10_disposition: terminal negative under its frozen first-native-child selector and exact-two-root gate; never reinterpreted or retried
history.new_question: fresh midpoint-shard all-child support under complete target precommit and paper-level inference

slots.exact_order: manifest order only; no substitution, reordering, resampling, or seed replacement
slots.dry_run_gate: the actual environment dry-run episode plan must equal every frozen example ID, slot ID and episode seed before the first fixture request

pass_inputs: exact target, alternative-index, rational-weight and HMAC-seed coverage
fixture_integration.failure: a structural, context, provenance, replay, seed, weight or scorer-completion failure stops before support; a flat or low-scoring semantic outcome does not

support_gate.per_paper_success: all two-to-four precommitted child targets exact-eligible with immutable 1/m weights summing to one and at least one target having K=4 F1 range at least 0.05
support_gate.early_failure: stop only when successes plus untouched remaining is less than 58; equivalently after the seventh paper failure
support_gate.truncated_inference: a curtailed prefix is terminal fail; never report a 64-paper rate or Wilson interval from it
support_gate.on_pass: terminate support compute and separately freeze and adversarially review stock, branch-global and local scientific arms
support_gate.on_fail: terminate and report a support failure; no scientific training

address_and_interruption_policy.observation_boundary: an address becomes irrevocably started when ADDRESS_STARTED is persisted immediately before its first model request
address_and_interruption_policy.atomicity: each paper is run sequentially and its complete chained artifacts are persisted before the next paper starts
address_and_interruption_policy.failure_after_any_address_started: terminal failure for the entire support campaign; preserve partial artifacts, never retry, replace, resume, or continue to later slots
address_and_interruption_policy.repair_before_any_address_started: at most one explicit bounded repair deployment is permitted only when no fixture or support ADDRESS_STARTED marker exists and no model request began
address_and_interruption_policy.continuation_after_repair: restart the unchanged full canonical fixture-and-support order only when no address ever started; continuation from a partial prefix is forbidden
address_and_interruption_policy.repair_requirements: a separately committed outcome-independent repair/amendment before any address; no scientific field changes; cumulative pod age and cost remain inside the original cap

runtime.live_eager_gate: engine log must contain enforce_eager=True and contain no CUDA graph profiling or capture before fixture requests
runtime.strict_tool_gate: strict tool environment marker and endpoint health required
runtime.per_trace_context_gate: recorded calls and every one-target branch bound must fit 8192 before any branch request

hardware.preferred: proven non-spot RTX 6000 Ada at 0.75 USD/hour
hardware.pods: at most one active pod; never create a duplicate
hardware.ssh: verify C:/Users/mihir/.ssh/id_rsa noninteractively before transfer; terminate immediately on failure

budget.cumulative_repair_rule: all initial and bounded-repair pod lifetimes and charges share this single six-hour/$4.50 envelope

artifact_policy.recover: all sentinels, per-slot recorded traces, precommits, context audits, replay/scorer/target reports, progress, logs, GPU ledger, hashes, terminal decision and billing
artifact_policy.compact: compress the complete evidence tree after local verification
artifact_policy.retain_model: only the already-local compressed selected adapter
artifact_policy.teardown: always terminate compute, confirm zero active pods and zero persistent disks, and record exact wallet billing
